description: The bar chart compares the performance of two different sampling strategies, Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy and Uniform Sampling Strategy, across various model sizes denoted by 'm'. The horizontal axis represents the model size, ranging from 6 to 10, while the vertical axis represents the MAP@10 metric, with values ranging from 23.0 to 27.0. The Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy is represented by purple bars, and the Uniform Sampling Strategy is represented by yellow bars. The Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy shows a consistent performance across all model sizes, with the MAP@10 values ranging from approximately 25.5 to 26.5. In contrast, the Uniform Sampling Strategy shows a decreasing trend in performance as the model size increases, with MAP@10 values ranging from approximately 25.5 to 24.5. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
